title: reportcategory
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, reportid, transactioncurrencyid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the report category record was created.

exchangerate.description: Exchange rate for the currency associated with the report category with respect to the base currency.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the report category was last modified.

owningbusinessunit.description: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the report category.

owninguser.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the report category.

reportcategoryid.description: Unique identifier of the report category.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the report category.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the report category.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the report category.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the report category.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the report category.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Unique identifier of the currency associated with the Report category.
